process_behavior.meaning: The council operates according to its charter and rules. It holds regular sessions, requires a quorum of three members physically present, and adopts ordinances by at least three affirmative votes of the full five-member council. The agenda for the 8 September 2026 session includes final action on Ordinance 2026-14. The sponsor can move postponement; otherwise, the item is voted on at that session.
